Scrape the section index pages (server-rendered HTML, no JS) and harvest anchor hrefs matching \.(xlsx|xls|pdf|csv)$ under /UserDocsImages/, then curl each file directly (200, application/vnd.openxmlformats...). HTTP GET with a real browser User-Agent header (default UAs are 403'd by Akamai bot protection). Fetch the index HTML pages (izvjestaji.html, tarife_naknada.html, obavijesti.html, press.html, karijere.html), regex-extract href to /content/dam/...*.pdf and /ba/popupeditpages/.../press/*.html, then GET each asset (URL-encode paths — many contain spaces/diacritics). Scrape the static HTML index pages (vendime-2, udhezime-mbrojtja, en/data-protection-legislation, projekt-akte-te-zyres-se-komisionerit, en/annual-reports, en/press-releases-2) for links, then download the linked PDFs from /wp-content/uploads/. Static HTTP GET. Static HTML scraping of the media sub-pages (news, tenders, publications, careers) — content is server-side rendered, no JS needed. Harvest PDF links (annual reports 'Raporti Vjetor' + quarterly 'Rezultate Financiare') from the publications page and download directly from /wp-content/uploads/. Both EN (/en/...) and SQ (/sq/...) trees available; SQ publications page is the richest for financial results.

Fetch https://www.mypos.com/sitemap.xml (200, application/xml, tested). Filter <loc> entries matching '/en-gb/newsroom/post/' (22), '/bg-bg/blog' (212), and localized '/hr-hr/...' paths, using <lastmod> for incremental crawling. Static HTTP scraping. Crawl the listing pages (English: /eng/c/105/annual-report, /eng/c/8/news, /eng/c/102/career-opportunities; Albanian: /c/46/pasqyra-financiare, /c/43/publikime), parse the yearly links to /d/{id}/{year} (or /eng/d/{id}/{year}) detail pages, then extract the direct PDF link (href under /media/*.pdf) and fetch it. Static scrape of the section pages (both /en/ English and Albanian roots): /en/legislation/guidelines/ (udhezime), /en/legislation/orders/ (urdhera), /en/legislation/ (ligje, VKM, draft acts /projekt-aktet/), /en/news-activities/publications/, /raporte/ (annual reports), /deklarata-fatf/ (FATF grey/black list). Parse anchor hrefs matching https://fiu.gov.al/wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/*.pdf and fetch the PDFs directly. No JS, no auth, no cookies needed. English filenames are prefixed 'ENG-'.

Static HTTP scrape via curl/requests. For A2/A3 tenders, poll the aktuelni-tenderi page (parse HTML for notice titles, publish/deadline dates, procurement contact email). EN and BS (/en/ vs /bs/) mirror versions exist for language coverage.

Fetch pages server-side (WebFetch / headless browser with a real browser User-Agent) since plain curl is WAF-blocked; scrape the finansijski-izvjestaji.html page for /document/documents/ISPBIH/.../*.pdf hrefs and download those PDFs directly for A1 disclosures and A4 statistics. For A5 jobs follow the external portal jobs.intesasanpaolo.com; for A3/A6 monitor the novosti and opsti-uslovi pages.

Plain HTTP GET with curl/requests; follow the www.ubb.bg -> ubb.bg 301 redirect (use -L / allow_redirects). Pages are fully server-side rendered, so scrape HTML directly. For A1/A3 disclosures: fetch /en/about/reports (or /bg/about/reports) and harvest href links matching /attachments/Tab/{id}/download_(en|bg)/*.pdf (197 PDF links present). For A1/A5 news & product intel: paginate /en/news?page=N (~210 pages) or use the year/category filters; each item has a date, category tag and link. For A5 jobs: scrape /en/careers/positions. Static HTTP scraping. Crawl the statistics page https://akep.al/publikime/statistika/ (SQ) and English mirror https://akep.al/en/publications/statistics/, plus the regulatory-acts and consultations index pages, and harvest links matching /wp-content/uploads/.*\.(pdf|docx). Files download directly via curl/GET with no auth, cookies, or JS. For A3 regulation/consultation monitoring, periodically diff the Steering Council decisions and consultation index pages.

Poll the WordPress RSS category feed https://banker.bg/category/finansovi-novini/feed/ (finance section) plus site-wide https://banker.bg/feed/ for new items; each item gives title, link, pubDate. Fetch individual article HTML via a real browser / browser-UA rendering fetcher (WebFetch-style) because plain curl is 403-blocked. Discover the full URL set via the sitemap index https://banker.bg/sitemap_index.xml (needs browser-like fetch). Filter feed items for BORICA/BLINK/BNB/payments/bank names for A1/A3/A6.

Scrape the annual-reports page (both /en/annual-reports and /sr/godisnji-izvjestaji) with a simple HTTP GET + HTML parse; collect all hrefs matching the pattern https://www.novabanka.com/download-godisnji/{numericID}/pdf/{URL-encoded-filename} and fetch each PDF directly (no auth, no cookies, no browser). For press releases (A1/A5/A6), crawl the paginated list at /sr/kategorija-novosti/saopstenja-za-javnost (and /obavjestenja-za-klijente) — ~26 pages, each /sr/novost/{slug} is a static article. Careers at /sr/karijera. All static HTML, reproducible with curl.

Site (HTML pages + wp-json REST) is behind Cloudflare 'challenge' and returns 403 to curl/WebFetch, BUT static assets under /wp-content/uploads/ are served directly (tested: annual-report-2010.pdf returned 200 application/pdf with valid %PDF-1.6 content). So: use a browser session to render the Raporte Vjetore / Lajmet e Fundit / Vende Vakante pages and harvest the /wp-content/uploads/*.pdf links, then download those PDFs directly with plain HTTP (no challenge on uploads). WordPress => reports follow /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/ naming.

Scrape the annual-reports and financial-reports listing pages (eng/ and shq/ paths) for /Uploads/Data/Files/*.pdf links and download directly (no auth/JS; PDF confirmed 11.3MB, application/pdf). The financial-reports (raportet-financiare) page 302-redirects to a year subpath — follow redirects and iterate year subpaths. Poll /shq/lajme/ and /shq/njoftime/ for A1/A3 news and product/payments pages for A6.

Scrape the year-organized report index pages (godishni-finansovi-otcheti and sibling reports/credit-rating/corporate-governance pages) for /bg/files/archive/<date>/... PDF links and download directly. News: scrape /bg/novini feed (filterable by year/month/category For investors/Press releases). Both BG and EN mirrors exist (/bg/ and /en/ path prefixes). No auth/JS.

Scrape the WordPress listing pages (izvjestaji-i-publikacije, novosti, press-kit, tarifnik-i-kamatne-stope, karijera) with plain HTTP GET; harvest /wp-content/uploads/*.pdf links for A1 financial disclosures. Static HTML, no JS needed. Optionally use WordPress REST API /wp-json/wp/v2/posts for the Novosti feed.

Scrape the server-rendered HTML sections (reports, saopstenja, karijera) with a simple HTTP client (curl/requests, no JS). Poll saopstenja-i-aktuelnosti and karijera pages for A1/A3/A5 items.

Scrape the finanijski-izvjestaji page for the yearly PDF links (pattern https://cdn0.erstegroup.com/content/dam/ba/sba/www.sparkasse.ba/<file>.pdf?forceDownload=1) and fetch each PDF directly over HTTPS; tested one PDF = HTTP 200, application/pdf, 166KB. Monitor /bs/korisne-informacije/obavijesti and /bs/press/informacije-za-medije for A3 notices.

Download Official Gazette issues directly from the Alfresco WebDAV path (FZ/{year}/{n}/FZ-{year}-{n}.pdf) — no login, supports HTTP range requests (206). Scrape the Cyrillic/Latin section pages (/cyr/aktuelno/javne-nabavke, /obavjestenja, /nova-izdanja) directly over HTTPS with a standard client; harvest PDF links under /uploads/pdfs/slglasnik/. Fetch pages and PDFs over HTTPS but MUST send a browser User-Agent header (default/curl/WebFetch UA is blocked with 403). Scrape the fees-and-interchange.html page for the ~40 per-country PDF hrefs under /content/dam/VCOM/regional/ve/unitedkingdom/PDF/fees-and-interchange/<period>/, then GET each PDF (no auth). Poll https://lidermedia.hr/rss.xml for new articles (site-wide feed, includes Financije/kripto items). Scrape /financial-reports/, /investor-relations/ and /news/ for hrefs under /static/uploads/*.pdf and *.xlsx; download consolidated reports (PDF) + Key Financial Data (xlsx) per period. Consistent naming: Addiko-Group-{Earnings-Release|Results-Presentation|Key-Financial-Data}-{PERIOD}.{pdf|xlsx}.

WordPress site: scrape /index.php/finansijski-izvjestaji/ for hrefs to /wp-content/uploads/*.pdf (annual reports, auditor reports, EN + SR statements). Scrape /index.php/novosti/ and /index.php/karijera/ (or /index.php/category/karijera/) for A5 early-intent/careers and A1/A3 news.

Scrape static HTML pages (en_about.html, en_financial.html, en_corporate_governance.html, en_terms.html, en_psd2api.html) and fetch linked PDFs under /assets/pdf/. Plain static site, no auth, no JS.

Direct HTTP GET of the .xlsx files under /web/files/documents/... (tested: HTTP 200, content-type application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 11.4KB). Scrape /bg/za-fgvb/statistika for current file links; scrape /bg/za-vlojitelite/banki for the member-bank list. No login required.

Scrape the listing page https://www.vienna-initiative.com/type/quarterly-deleveraging-monitors/ for inline PDF links under /content/dam/viennainitiative/pdf/ and download each report; newest NPL Monitors link out to EBRD news pages so also follow those. Static HTML + direct PDF URLs, no auth.
GET yearly PDFs at predictable path https://www.teke.gr/pages/ABOUT/files/Annual_Report_YYYY_GR.pdf (confirmed 2020, 2022, 2024). Poll each March for the new year's Apologismos.

Poll the consolidated RSS (https://3e-news.net/bg/rss redirects to /rss/all.xml, valid RSS 2.0, HTTP 200) for latest items; scrape the Finance category page (/bg/a/category/7/finansi) for section-specific listings since per-category RSS (/bg/rss/category/7) returns 404.

Direct GET the report PDF (link above, no gating/form). Also harvest UK-led and EU-led horizon-scanning webinar slide PDFs from same /en/download/media/... path. For ongoing coverage, poll the /en/insights hub HTML for new dated items.

Poll the category RSS feed https://www.boyanov.com/category/news-and-deals/feed/ (HTTP 200, application/rss+xml) for new legal/deal posts; fall back to HTML parsing of the category listing. Standard WordPress site.
Scrape the page for per-year DOCX links (hosted under vlada.gov.hr/UserDocsImages) and download the latest annual legislative plan/programme; parse for upcoming banking/finance laws & deadlines (A3).

Poll the per-rubric RSS feeds at www.capital.bg/rss/?rubrid=<ID> (IDs listed on rss.php). MUST send a browser User-Agent — Cloudflare returns HTTP 403 to default/bot UAs; with a browser UA the index and feeds return valid XML. www2.* canonicalises to www.capital.bg.

Scrape HTML listing pages: Greece press releases (https://www.deloitte.com/gr/en/about/press-room/press-releases.html) and industry/insights hubs (banking-capital-markets, financial-services, tax alerts). Headlines/links are server-rendered in the HTML, so a plain GET + HTML parse works, no browser session or auth needed. For research reports (Digital Banking Maturity, Regulatory Outlook) follow article pages to linked PDFs and download individually as needed.

Scrape HTML insight/industry pages. Poll the regulatory-insights hub (https://kpmg.com/xx/en/our-insights/regulatory-insights.html) and the annual '20xx Financial Services Regulatory Priorities' articles for A3; scrape Greece People Services pages (executive-search-selection.html, compensation-benefits-surveys.html) and industries/banking.html for A2/A5. Scrape the server-rendered HTML of the hub pages (BCM industry page, /en_gr/technical/tax/tax-alerts, and en_gl EMEIA insight URLs) and follow article links; content is present in HTML (AEM), no auth/JS needed. Use a browser-like User-Agent.

Scrape investors.dieboldnixdorf.com/news-and-events/press-releases (IR platform, year-indexed URLs .../press-releases/news-details/2026/...) or news.dieboldnixdorf.com/press-releases. IR sites usually expose an RSS feed - check for one.

Scrape the HTML project register at https://www.eib.org/en/projects/loans/index.htm?countries=GR (signed loans) and https://www.eib.org/en/projects/all/ (paginated); also monitor procurement page https://www.eib.org/en/about/procurement/index. No public CSV/JSON export; data.europa.eu EIB dataset distributions merely link back to these HTML pages. All three sample URLs return HTTP 200.

Static HTTP GET scraping. Fetch https://www.payten.com/en/news-events/news/ (nginx, 200, text/html, fully server-rendered — no browser/JS required). Parse article links matching the pattern /en/news-events/news/{slug}/ and follow pagination via ?page=N (?page=2 returns 200). Each article page is plain HTML with title, date and body. Poll periodically for A6 competitor/vendor intelligence. For product/offer pages (e.g. /en/offers/for-merchants/payment-acceptance/, /en/offers/for-payment-financial-institutions/atm-related-services/moneyget-atm-network/) fetch directly, also static HTML.

sources.recommended_method: Scrape with a plain HTTP GET client (curl/requests) sending a real browser User-Agent header — this bypasses the Cloudflare bot rule that returns 403 to WebFetch/default agents. Pages are fully server-rendered, no JS or API needed. Crawl the issuer register at /ucesnici-na-trzistu/emitenti (one page, ~855 rows), then follow each /ucesnici-na-trzistu/emitenti/{code} profile for per-issuer tables. Poll /novosti, /obavjestenja, /finansijski-izvjestaji and /odluke/odobrenja-emisije-vp-javnom-ponudom for A3/A1/A4 updates and parse linked PDF/DOC files. Add polite rate-limiting (one request timed out once; retry logic recommended).

HTTP GET on server-rendered pages: /press (EN newsroom) and /hr-HR/novosti (Croatian news/blog), paginate via ?p=N (e.g. /press?p=1). Also /hr-HR/regulatory-info (A3 regulation) and /about (A1). Content is present in raw HTML, so plain curl/HTTP fetch works without a browser. For job openings (A5), the /careers page renders the list via a Talentlyft JS widget (talentlyftWidget) rather than server HTML, so use the Talentlyft feed/widget or a headless browser for jobs specifically.

Static HTML scraping. Crawl section landing pages (news /bs/novosti/kratke-vijesti and /bs/novosti/bhbankar, events /bs/dogadjaji, jobs /bs/novosti/zaposljavanje, tag pages e.g. /bs/novosti/tag/platni_promet, member banks /bs/banke-clanice, documents /bs/dokumenti/prezentacije) then follow item detail links. English mirror under /en. Pages are server-rendered, so plain HTTP GET + HTML parser (BeautifulSoup/Cheerio) works; no JS execution or login needed. robots.txt allows all crawling. Downloadable files (PDF/PPT White Books, presentations) live on document detail pages - follow through to capture direct file links.

Scrape the server-rendered list at https://www.strategy.bg/bg/public-consultations with GET query params: fieldOfAction=21 (Financial policy), plus optional actType, institution, administrative-level filters, and page=N pagination (?page=1..~500). Each row links to a detail page https://www.strategy.bg/bg/public-consultations/{id} (e.g. /12514) carrying title, dates, institution and attached document links. For low-latency change detection, poll the Atom feed https://www.strategy.bg/public-consultation.rss (Content-Type application/xml). No login/JS/cookies beyond a harmless session cookie are required; plain HTTP GET reproduces everything outside a browser.

Scrape HTML at https://ingenico.com/en/newsroom/press-releases and /en/newsroom/blogs; follow ?page=N pagination ('Show me more' link). Item links follow /en/newsroom/press-releases/<slug>. No auth, no RSS observed.

Poll RSS feeds on a schedule with a plain HTTP GET (no JS, no auth). Use https://www.bug.hr/rss for all posts, https://www.bug.hr/rss/biznis for business/IT, and https://www.bug.hr/rss/fintech for fintech/payments/crypto/regulation. Feeds are RSS 2.0 with <title>, <link>, <category>, <description>, <pubDate>. Pattern is https://www.bug.hr/rss/<section-or-tag>. For deeper article text, follow each item <link> and scrape the static HTML. ttl=30 min, so poll ~30-60 min.

sources.recommended_method: Scrape the paginated public notice listings (njoftimi-i-fituesit, njoftimi-i-kontrates-se-shpallur, njoftime by year) — each server-rendered HTML page (~10 records; 3600+ pages) lists tenders with document links via /GetData/DownloadDocument?documentId=...&docType=.... Scrape HTML list at https://www.epant.gr/apofaseis-gnomodotiseis.html (EL) or /en/decisions.html (EN), paginating with ?start=N (increments of ~23; 45 pages EL / 16 EN). Follow item links to /apofaseis-gnomodotiseis/item/<id>-*.html to get full decision text and PDF links. Can also filter by year-tag URLs or company tags (e.g. Piraeus Bank). For sector inquiries, download PDF reports directly from /files/<year>/*.pdf. No auth, no JS, no API needed — plain GET + HTML parse.

Scrape static HTML listing https://usa.visa.com/about-visa/newsroom/press-releases-listing.html (headlines+links present in server HTML, no JS needed); follow /about-visa/newsroom/press-releases.releaseId.<ID>.html for full text. No RSS/API exposed.

Scrape the blog index (https://www.paysera.com/v2/en/blog -> redirects to /blog-international), the press/newsroom page (https://www.paysera.com/v2/en/press, 'More press releases...' link), and localized editions (Bulgarian: https://www.paysera.com/v2/bg/blog-bulgaria; Albania articles under /v2/en/blog/*-albania). Article titles + dates are in server-rendered HTML (curl/WebFetch works on article/blog/press pages). Use a realistic browser User-Agent because the site root returns HTTP 403 to bare curl (bot protection); article and section pages return 200. Career/jobs at /v2/en/career for A5. No RSS feed found.

HTML scraping of the ASP.NET pages (no browser/JS needed; curl+WebFetch return full content, HTTP 200, IIS/10.0). For the full issuer universe, iterate the A-Z index EmitentiIndex.aspx?l=<letter> (a..z / local chars) to collect EmitentiFull.aspx?id=<UUID> detail links, then fetch each detail page. Recent-changes and prospectus/session/announcement lists are paginated via ASP.NET __doPostBack POSTs carrying __VIEWSTATE/__EVENTVALIDATION, or scrape sequential list pages. Download prospectus/regulation PDFs directly from their href links.

HTML scraping. Crawl section pages (/finance/, /business, /economics, /company) and tag/company pages (/about/{tag}) which contain article links directly in static HTML (content-type text/html). Paginate with ?page=N (tested ?page=2 -> HTTP 200). Article pages follow /{category}/{slug}.html and are also static HTML. Respect robots.txt crawl-delay: 10s. No auth/cookies/JS needed.

Poll RSS feeds (https://www.index.hr/rss and https://www.index.hr/rss/vijesti) via simple HTTP GET for latest business/regulation news (A1/A3); returns clean XML with category tags, no auth/JS needed. For topical monitoring (A1/A3), scrape the HTML tag pages (all HTTP 200) e.g. /tag/796/hnb.aspx, /tag/53893/kreditni-rejting.aspx, /tag/232442/biznis.aspx, /tag/1040094/fintech-konferencija-shift-money.aspx, /tag/178044/businesshr.aspx and follow /clanak links. For A5 early-intent monitor the banking jobs board at https://www.index.hr/oglasi/poslovi/bankarstvo.

For A1 corporate disclosures: scrape the financial statements download hub (https://www.hbor.hr/naslovnica/hbor/financijska-izvjesca-pregled-preuzimanje/) and the financial plans page for PDF/DOCX links; a fixed publication calendar exists (Q1 by 31 May, H1 by 31 Aug, 9M by 30 Nov, annual by 30 Apr) so poll around those dates. English equivalent at /financial-performance/322. For A3/A5 news: scrape /category/obavijesti (news/priopcenja) and /otvoreni-natjecaji (open calls). For A2 tenders/procurement: HBOR's own /javna-nabava/132 only holds rules + archive; active tenders are published on Croatia's national e-procurement portal EOJN (https://eojn.nn.hr/Oglasnik/) — collect HBOR tenders there by contracting authority.

Plain HTML scrape of the bilingual page set: /en/about-us/overview/ (and /hr/), /en/company-data/, /en/merchants-solutions/overview/ and /card-acceptance/acquiring-agreements/, /en/banks-and-financial-institutions/acquiring/atm-solutions/. Static server-rendered HTML, no JS or API needed. Use these for A1 (company profile/management), A6 (vendor/competitor product & acquiring/ATM offering). Note: Nexi Croatia d.o.o. does NOT publish financial statements or annual reports on this site — for A1 financial disclosures collect them from the Croatian court/company registry (sudreg.pravosudje.hr) or FINA rgfi by OIB, not from nexi.hr.

Scrape server-rendered HTML. Recommendations register: GET https://www.synigoroskatanaloti.gr/el/systaseis-porismata?page=N (57 pages, 0-indexed); filter Financial Services via subject-category facet. Each item is an HTML decision page; follow for text/PDF. Annual reports: /en(or el)/annual-report-YYYY pages (2005-2021), PDFs on each report page. News by category: /el/nea?field_category_target_id=3.

Scrape HTML news list at https://www.nexi.gr/en/Resources/news/ (dated items render server-side; page has year/month/topic filters and a 'see more' button — check for AJAX pagination query params if deeper history needed, but initial items are in static HTML). Also scrape /en/pos/ product category pages and /en/whatsnew/ for A6/A1 signals. EN and EL (/el/) variants available.

Poll RSS feeds https://www.bta.bg/en/rss/free (English) and https://www.bta.bg/bg/rss/free (Bulgarian) via simple HTTP GET (text/xml, no auth, updatePeriod hourly) for new items; for section pages fetch HTML listings like https://www.bta.bg/en/news/economy and follow article links (e.g. /en/news/671544-... which returns 200). No JS needed for server-rendered HTML.

Poll the RSS feeds (e.g. https://www.economic.bg/rss/all.xml for all news, https://www.economic.bg/rss/biznes.xml, /rss/sektorni-novini.xml, /rss/biznes-radar.xml) for A1/A3/A5/A6 monitoring; supplement with HTML scraping of the Finance/Banks category page (/bg/category/finansi/banki.html) which is server-rendered and paginated. No JS or auth needed. Filter items by bank/ABB/fintech keywords.

Scrape the izvjestaji-emitenta and godisnji-izvjestaji index pages for the dated PDF/XLSX links, then fetch each report file directly over HTTPS (static server, no JS/API needed). Also monitor /saopcenja-i-aktuelnosti/saopcenja1 (press) and /saopcenja-i-aktuelnosti/finansijski-kalendar for A3 deadlines.

download.type: PDF (Visa fact sheet, Visa Direct fact sheets, corporate media kit)

sources.recommended_method: Static HTML scraping of the newsroom and per-country pages (/albania.html, /albania/news.html, /bosnia-n-herzegovina.html). No JS or auth needed. Poll newsroom for new press releases; harvest linked PDF fact sheets. No RSS/API detected.

Scrape each participants page (WordPress) for the linked dated .xlsx (filename pattern YYYYMMDD-RT1-SCT-Inst-Reachable-PSP-List_CUG.xlsx). Download the periodically-refreshed XLSX and parse. Repeat for STEP2 SCT participants page. Filter rows to Greek PSPs (GR BIC/country).

api.params: none (RSS of consultations list); HTML page supports query filters: keywords, status, opening/deadline date, subject

sources.recommended_method: Poll the consultations RSS feed https://finance.ec.europa.eu/node/1066/rss_en for new/updated consultations (A3 deadlines), and/or scrape the filtered HTML list. No auth. English + other EU languages available via _en/_el suffix.
GET RSS https://thefintechtimes.com/feed/ (application/rss+xml). Category feeds also available (e.g. /category/<x>/feed/). Note: wp-json REST API is blocked (403).

Poll RSS feed https://www.e-nomothesia.gr/rss.xml (text/xml, 200, includes pubDate/lastBuildDate) for new items; scrape HTML category pages e.g. banking category https://www.e-nomothesia.gr/kat-trapezes-pistotika-idrumata/ and law-news listing (paginated 1-11+). Static server-rendered HTML, no auth, no JS needed.

Scrape the delegation tenders/procurement-planning HTML pages (Albania: /delegations/albania/... procurement-planning pages; BiH: /delegations/bosnia-and-herzegovina/tenders_en) and the central filterable listing https://www.eeas.europa.eu/eeas/tenders_en (filter by Contracting Authority = the relevant delegation). Pages are server-rendered Drupal HTML, curl-fetchable without JS/auth. Delegation tender pages announce negotiated procedures (EUR 15k–143k) via email; the procurement-planning page enumerates the delegation's annual procedures (13 items listed for Albania 2026).

HTTP/WebFetch scrape of each country's /en/<cc>/legal-updates listing (bgr, alb via banking-finance expertise page, hrv insight-hub) on a schedule; parse article cards (title/date/tags) and follow links; filter to Banking & Finance / FinTech / AML topics. Pages are server-rendered so plain GET works. Optional 'Personalised updates' email subscription exists but is not required.

Retarget collection to the successors: (1) Erste Bank Croatia press releases https://www.erstebank.hr/hr/press/priopcenja-za-medije (A1/A5 news) and financial reports https://www.erstebank.hr/hr/o-nama/financijska-izvjesca (A1 PDFs); (2) Diners Club Hrvatska https://diners.hr/ (card products/news); (3) Global Payments corporate news for the acquiring business; (4) Croatian court register (sudreg.pravosudje.hr) / FINA for Erste Card Club d.o.o. company & management data. Scrape via plain HTTP/HTML; no API or auth needed.

HTML scraping. Content is fully server-rendered (finance category page title 'Financë - Punë aktive - <date>', BKT employer page 'Banka Kombetare Tregtare BKT' both returned in raw HTML), so a plain HTTP GET + HTML parser works without a browser. Crawl /search/category/finance for finance listings and /employers/<slug> for target-employer job activity. No public JSON API or sitemap.xml (404) found; robots.txt exists (200) — respect it.

Plain HTTP GET the /pretraga-poslova search URLs (no auth, no JS needed). Nuxt SSR renders job cards directly into the HTML (1000+ data-v- nodes, job titles/employers present), so parse listings from the returned HTML. Use query params to filter (positions=IT, sortBy=adtype) and paginate. Homepage and /poslovi also return 200. An internal JSON/GraphQL API likely exists (references to baseURL in bundle) but was not needed — SSR HTML is sufficient and reproducible outside a browser.

Plain HTTP GET + HTML parsing (Apache server, HTTP 200, static server-rendered pages, no JS or auth needed). Crawl /propisi/<jurisdiction>/<slug>.html for legal texts, and registar-sluzbenih-glasila.html plus arhiva-sluzbenih-novina-fbih.html for gazette issue links. Content served inline as HTML; poll the register / 'Alarm za glasila' section for new gazette issues.
Scrape section index pages (e.g. /banke/) for article links + dates, then fetch article HTML. RSS probes (/feed,/rss) only redirect to HTML, so use section-list scraping with pagination
Scrape the MREL hub pages (mrel, mrel-dashboard-0, mrel-repository-documents) for /system/files/media/document/*.pdf links and download the semi-annual MREL Dashboard PDFs. Static HTML, no auth.

Static HTTP GET / HTML scrape of per-act pages (/z/<id>/<slug> and /c/podzakonski-propis/<id>/<slug>). robots.txt allows all; sitemap at https://www.zakon.hr/s/tmp/sitemap/sitemap.xml enumerates all acts. Slugs are versioned yearly (301 redirects to current, e.g. .../-2026) so follow redirects to get latest consolidated text. For official/authoritative text cross-reference Narodne novine (narodne-novine.nn.hr).

HTTP GET + HTML scrape of category pages with pagination (/kategoria/ekonomi/{page}) and tag pages (/tag/{id}); articles at /lajm/{slug}. Server-rendered, no JS or auth needed. Poll for A1 (bank PR/news) and A3 (regulation) keywords in Albanian.

HTTP GET + HTML scrape of corporate pages and /en/blog/ (and SQ equivalents) for A1 corporate/newsroom, A6 vendor/competitor profiling; /en/karriera/ for A5 jobs/early-intent. Server-rendered, no auth.

Poll the main RSS feed https://www.dnevnik.bg/rss/ (valid RSS 2.0, HTTP 200) for new items, then filter by category/URL path (biznes, finansi, pr_sfera) for A2/A3/A5. Section HTML pages such as /biznes/finansi/ return 200 and can be scraped with a browser-like User-Agent; the homepage and some article pages return 403 to plain curl (CDN/bot protection), so send a realistic UA/Accept header.

HTTP GET scrape of /pretraga-poslova with positions= filter (Bankarstvo, plus IT/payments keyword searches), paginate through result pages and parse listing cards server-side (no JS needed). Respect robots.txt (search results allowed; only specific ?source=/utm params disallowed). Optional: subscribe to per-search e-mail alerts as a change signal.

Deloitte has migrated www2.deloitte.com to www.deloitte.com. The old article/tax-alert URLs 301 to generic www.deloitte.com/ce landing pages. For automated collection, crawl the new www.deloitte.com/ce/en (services/insights/research) and country pages (/al, /bg) for banking outlook + tax/legal alert articles, and download linked PDFs from the /content/dam/ DAM. Publicly accessible HTML/PDF, no auth. Refresh saved URLs to the new domain.

Scrape noticeSearchResults.html with a browser-like User-Agent header (mandatory - default curl UA gets nginx 403). Individual notices are public at /delta/viewNotice.html?displayNoticeId={id}. Filter by country to isolate Albania/Bosnia. Also cross-check the human-friendly aggregate list at https://www.ebrd.com/home/work-with-us/project-procurement/procurement-notices.html . Login+MFA only required to submit responses, not to read notices.

download.url: Media kit ZIP + brand-asset packages linked from /newsroom (hosted on Google Cloud Storage)

For A5, scrape https://payhawk.com/careers — jobs are server-side rendered into the page and backed by Greenhouse (job_post IDs like 4000039101 visible in the ai_opt_out links); the rendered HTML is directly scrapable without JS.

Plain HTTP scrape (static Apache HTML, no JS). Crawl listing pages /hr/plan-nabavki, /hr/javne-nabavke, /hr/arhiva-javni-nabavki, /hr/ministarstvo-finansija and the hronoloski-registar page; follow detail-page links to PDF documents under /uploads/documents/. Available in bs/hr/sr/en locale prefixes.
Scrape HTML blog listing at /blog (tag-based) plus /en/press and /case-studies; HubSpot CMS so pages are server-rendered and curl-reachable. Try /blog/rss for a feed.

Scrape HTML pages: /en/pages/about-us, the In-the-Press section, and /en/policies/terms-of-service for product/company intel (A5 early-intent / A6 vendor). No auth, server-rendered enough for WebFetch.

Scrape the HTML register with pagination: GET https://www.dpa.gr/el/enimerwtiko/prakseisArxis?page=N (N=0..~151), Drupal exposed-filter params available (field_year_from/to, field_category, field_thematic, field_keywords). Scrape server-rendered HTML: crawl /nomothesia/ index for /nomothesia/nomos-{number}-{year}/ links and tag pages (/etiketes/{slug}/); no auth/JS. No RSS/API exposed, so paginate/crawl the HTML listings.

Periodic HTML scrape of the English (/en/...) and Albanian sections — About Us, Products & Services, Activities, Job Vacancies, Contact — for corporate profile (A1), vendor/competitor intel (A6) and early-intent signals (A5). Content is fully static; simple GET + HTML parse works, no JS/API needed.

Scrape the EN (and BG) HTML pages: /en (home, date/venue), /en/speakers, plus Partners/Advisory Board/Blog for vendor/competitor (A6) and event-driven (A2/A5) intelligence. Static HTML via GET; note WebFetch is 403-blocked but curl with a Mozilla UA returns full content (uses declarative shadow-DOM templates, but content is in the served HTML).

Plain HTTP scrape of the WordPress site. All 4 sample URLs return 200 with plain curl (no JS). Crawl /finansijski-izvjestaji/ and its child pages plus /vijesti/ (konkurs = job postings appear as news items) and /zaposlenje-u-banci/; harvest PDF links under /wp-content/uploads/. English mirror at /en/... , German at /de/... . Optional: WP REST API at /wp-json/wp/v2/ may be available.

Fetch the clean-path WebSphere Portal URLs (e.g. /wps/portal/nra/registers-i-spisuci, .../registers, and .../fiskalni-ustroystva-supto-i-e-magazini/... ) with curl -k (or a full CA bundle): the server presents an INCOMPLETE TLS chain, so strict validation fails ('unable to verify the first certificate') - this is why WebFetch errored. Use -k / supply the intermediate cert. Pages are server-rendered HTML (no JS). Ignore the volatile '!ut/p/z1/...' session-token variants and use the readable clean paths. Register detail pages link to downloadable model lists; note approved-model registers are legally maintained by BIM (Bulgarian Institute of Metrology).

Static HTML scraping (nginx, server-rendered). Poll /about-us/board/, /events-overview/ (+ past events), and the News/Member News listings. Membership directory at /membership-benefits/membership-directory/ for member org list. No API/JS needed; simple HTTP GET + HTML parse.

Fetch per-law URLs by stable ldoc ID (e.g. /bg/laws/ldoc/2137182267 for ZPUPS, /bg/laws/ldoc/2137244903 for Euro Introduction Law) and parse HTML; DECODE from windows-1251 to UTF-8. HTML scrape of /en/news (and BG /news) for scheme announcements and of the partners page for the certified-PSP list. Apache serves static HTML 200; both EN and BG versions exist. No downloadable statistics on-site.

Scrape the static HTML service/category pages (/c/51/pagesa payments, /transferta-parash money transfer, /d/82/arketime bill-collection). Scrape HTML. Events page is server-side rendered with full event details (name, date, description); parse the listing and per-event pages (e.g. /events/fintech-athens-40).

GET-scrape the HTML with a normal browser User-Agent (Akamai blocks generic bot UAs -> WebFetch got 403, but plain curl returns 200). Parse the ~23 <a href='/gr/en/publications/financial-services/*.html'> links; individual reports often link to PDFs. Same approach for /gr/en/newsletters/legal-news.html.

Server-side GET to /searchJob/index.php with sector filter and large _pagerRows; parse the HTML job cards (title, employer, location, date). Fully reproducible outside a browser (200, no cookies). Note charset is windows-1251. Verify/adjust sector IDs to the banking/finance codes (the sample 112,113,116,117 map to IT/energy/industry sectors, not banking).
Static HTTP GET + HTML parse of /bg/jobs (careers, A5/A6) and /bg/news (corporate news, A3/A6). No auth, no JS. English variants under /en/. Poll periodically for new openings/news.

HTTP GET + HTML parse of homepage (Novosti feed replaces old aktuelno.php) plus /Content/Read/zakoni for laws and the Javni pozivi/obavijesti section for bank-selection public calls; documents linked as PDFs. IIS/.NET routes use GET only (HEAD returns 405).

Economic Indicators at https://www.irbrs.net/statistika/Default.aspx (ASP.NET WebForms) and Placed Credits DB https://www.irbrs.net/PlasiraniKreditiBaza/. All server-rendered HTTP GET.

Static HTML site: scrape the relevant topic pages (javne-nabavke-BiH.html for A2 procurement law/case-law, bankarsko-pravo.html for A3 banking law, legislation-bosnia.html for consolidated legislation index) and follow linked PDF laws/decisions. Simple HTTP GET, no JS.

Scrape the propisi.php list (server-rendered, no JS), enumerate propis.php?id=N detail pages, and harvest linked PDFs for A3 regulation/deadline tracking and A1 FBA annual reports. Watch for new banking (bankarstvo/banke) entries.

Static HTML scrape of easypay.bg/site/ pages (?p=documents, ?p=atm) with query-param routing; EN and BG versions available (/site/en/). No JS needed.
Static HTML scrape of the news section (EN /en and BG /) for euro-adoption announcements and deadlines; no JS or API required.

Scrape sitemap.xml to enumerate URLs, then crawl https://www.procreditbank.ba/blog and /blog/arhiva for client announcements (A3) and https://www.procreditbank.ba/karijera/pozicije for jobs. HTML scrape of https://faktor.ba/ekonomija (Najnovije/Najcitanije listings) and follow article links. No RSS available — /rss, /feed, /rss.xml, /ekonomija/feed, /sitemap.xml all return the Next.js SPA HTML shell (soft-200), not a real feed. Parse listing HTML for headlines/links/dates.

Scrape the /about-us/news HTML listing with pagination (numbered pages 1-10+), plus /solutions/* product pages. Static server-rendered HTML (IIS), no JS needed. No RSS feed exists (feed/, rss, news/feed all 404).

Scrape static HTML pages (Cloudflare-fronted, PHP). Root ak-invest.com 301-redirects to www.ak-invest.com; use www. Target the Careers page (under company info) for A5/early-intent and About/governance for A1. No API detected.
Scrape the Newsroom and tag pages (e.g. /tag/albania/) and Banking & Finance expertise page HTML; check for a WordPress /feed/ or /wp-json to simplify. Static HTML, no JS needed.

HTML scraping of /njoftime-pune category pages (use the 'finance' category for A5/A6 finance-sector hiring). Listings render server-side in curl (HTTP 200) despite Cloudflare; scrape job title/company/city/type/snippet. Albanian source is primary; /en/ mirror available for English.

HTTP GET + HTML scrape of article pages (/news/<slug>); discover new banking/payments articles via on-site search endpoint https://albaniandailynews.com/search?q=<term> (returns 200) or via keyword site: queries. Article body is in server-rendered HTML.

Collect via WebFetch or a headless browser — Cloudflare returns 403 to bare curl. Poll the Finance (cat 15) and Business (cat 1) category pages; an RSS endpoint (/services/rss.php) exists but is also Cloudflare-gated to non-browser clients.
Static HTML scraping of the news (p=news) and about/terms (p=about) pages via ?lang=en / ?lang=bg. Homepage 302-redirects to /v3main/front?lang=bg.
Direct static HTML scrape of each /conditions/{country}/ page (nginx, HTTP 200, text/html). One page per country; parse tables/paragraphs for operator shares, penetration, VAT, pricing.

Static HTML scrape (Joomla CMS, Cloudflare, HTTP 200). Monitor the news/njoftime and Career Center pages for bank internship/job postings (A5 early-intent) and Finance Department pages (A3/A4). Some PDFs (programs, regulations) linked inline.

Scrape DEI pages (server-rendered Apache, EN + BS) for IPA III/WBIF programming documents, action fiches and regulation PDFs (A2 tenders/A3 regulation/A4 funding). Cross-reference EC enlargement portal for canonical IPA docs.

Scrape static HTML listing pages: the Ekonomija section (https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/ekonomija/) and tag pages such as /tag/platni-promet/. Article cards (headline, image, teaser, URL) render server-side; paginate the listing and follow article links. No JS needed.
